Class ToolResponseAttachment

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.agi.tool.ToolResponseAttachment
All Implemented Interfaces:
Displayable
public final class ToolResponseAttachment extends Object implements Displayable
Represents a binary attachment associated with a tool's response. This is used to capture non-textual output from tool execution, such as images, PDFs, or other data blobs.

anahata
